assessment_summary: Reviewed the guide (Develop section: npm install, npm start on http://localhost:8080/, npm run build → dist/) and the installation summary; validated on the same container. Inspected the repo at /workspace (commit 24041c0), confirmed Node v20.20.2/npm 10.8.2 on PATH, and verified dependencies (~283 node_modules incl. maplibre-gl, webpack, webpack-cli, webpack-dev-server) with package-lock.json. Confirmed the built artifacts in dist/ (bundle.js ~1.295 MB, index.html, oss-licenses.json, img/, vendor/maplibre). Ran the actual software: `npm start` (webpack serve) compiled 152 modules with only warnings and served the app; curl returned HTTP 200 for `/` (9372 bytes, <title>QuattroMap</title>), `/bundle.js` (1,356,256 bytes) and the vendored maplibre worker. Additionally served the production dist/ independently (all key paths HTTP 200) and validated bundle integrity with `node --check` (exit 0) plus app feature markers (crosshair/geocoder/config layer name) embedded in the bundle. All validation-spawned processes were terminated and ports released. Limitations: no GUI browser was available, so live map-tile rendering from external WMS/XYZ services was not exercised; and webpack-dev-server@6.0.0 emits an EBADENGINE warning (declares node >=22.15.0) against the installed Node 20, but this did not prevent compilation or serving. These are warnings/environmental constraints, not installation defects. The documented install method is complete and the application builds, starts, and serves as described — objective evidence supports success.
